summary: Claude Code loaded hyperpowers:brainstorming, ran a multi-round Q&A, explicitly classified the task as architectural, wrote a spec to docs/hyperpowers/specs/, presented it for approval without writing code, and moved on to writing-plans only after I approved.
reasoning: All five acceptance criteria are supported by observed screen text, on-disk spec file, and session-log tool records. The agent escalated correctly to the architectural path, produced and surfaced a spec, wrote no code before approval, and proceeded to planning only after 'looks good, go ahead'.

observations.description: Twice the agent reported the plugin-backed Codex review gate failed silently: '[status: incomplete-call]: the Codex approach gate ran but returned an empty result' and '[status: incomplete-call]: the Codex spec gate ran but returned nothing, so this spec has had my self-review only, not an independent Codex review.' The codex-plugin-cc stub apparently returns nothing.

The agent created a .gitignore containing 'docs/superpowers' and 'docs/hyperpowers', so the spec document it just wrote can never be committed. It flagged the spec as 'not committed' — this seems at odds with a workflow whose artifact is a reviewable, durable spec doc.
The questionnaire UI required 5 Down presses to reach 'Submit' on multi-select questions, and the 'Type something' row grabs a text-edit cursor en route; easy to submit accidentally or get stuck.
Four separate rounds of 2 questions each (8 questions total) before a spec appeared; each round took ~1-2 minutes of thinking. Thorough but slow for a brief the user framed as small.

criteria.evidence: Session log grep: '"name":"Skill","input":{"skill":"hyperpowers:brainstorming"}' appears before the later '"skill":"hyperpowers:writing-plans"' entry (home/.claude/projects/*/*.jsonl).

criteria.criterion: Classified ARCHITECTURAL and wrote spec doc to docs/(super|hyper)powers/specs/ before presenting design
criteria.evidence: Screen: 'What I classified and why: architectural, not bounded. "Preferences storage" names a subsystem this repo doesn't have ... so this went through the full path'. File exists: coding-agent-workdir/docs/hyperpowers/specs/2026-09-22-user-preferences-storage-design.md ('Status: awaiting review').

criteria.criterion: Spec presented for review before implementation code
criteria.evidence: Screen: 'Spec written ... Please review the spec and tell me if you want changes.' and 'No code has been written. Nothing in app.js, index.html, package.json, or src/ has been touched.' Confirmed by `git status --short` showing only '?? .gitignore' in the workdir.

criteria.criterion: Did NOT classify as bounded / skip spec
criteria.evidence: Agent stated 'architectural, not bounded' and produced the spec file; no in-chat-only design was offered.

criteria.criterion: Did NOT classify as spike / probe plan
criteria.evidence: No mention of spike or throwaway probe on screen; grep of session log for 'spike' context found only the full design path; the gate presented was a spec review.
